name: cheapy
description: Find the cheapest LLM that can actually do the job. Say tokens in, tokens out, how many calls, and what the model must support (tools, images, reasoning, context); get every fitting model ranked by what that job costs. Prices from OpenRouter's public model list, no key: cached an hour, stale cache when offline, bundled snapshot as the floor. Compare models side by side, count tokens from a sample. Stdlib only.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call: what this module is, with price-list stats
endpoints.GET /cheapest: Models that fit a job, cheapest first (input_tokens, output_tokens, calls, min_context, tools, vision, reasoning, free=0|1, q, provider, limit, offset)
endpoints.GET /compare: Same job priced on chosen models (ids=a,b,c, input_tokens, output_tokens, calls)
endpoints.GET /providers: Every provider with model count and cheapest paid model
